images.alt: The app launcher: six circular tiles for Fingerprint, Test wash, Measure, Inspections, Returns and Packing, with Returns marked offline.

caption.tail: An eighth tile advertises work that had not been built yet.

images.alt: Receiving: a purchase order grid tracking scanned SKUs, with the current garment card showing two of ten units received.

caption.tail: Net-new inventory scanned in, unit by unit, against the order.

images.alt: Returning: six garments from one customer's tote in a row, two of them scanned and carrying a wash code, the other four still unread.

caption.tail: Six garments from one customer's order.

images.alt: Inspection: a returned garment beside a grid of damage types, stain selected, with pass and fail as the two verdicts.

caption.tail: Damage named from a fixed vocabulary, then passed or failed.

images.alt: Packing: three garment bag sizes offered for the order, the large bag chosen.

caption.tail: The packaging decided from the order, not from memory.

images.alt: Fingerprint: a garment's card with a large confirmation mark over the photo, the style name and colourway below it.

caption.tail: The garment is registered to Nuuly.

images.alt: Test Wash: the wash cycle for a new style set to W3, delicate lights, applying to every size of the style, with the dry clean alternative unset.

caption.tail: One cycle, set for every size of the style.

images.alt: Measure: a numeric keypad with a fraction key, for entering imperial measurements without a keyboard.

caption.tail: Imperial fractions, entered without a keyboard.
